outcome: The exact original Vulkan fragment for the current installed Default Lit Full Lighting resolver candidate is exported and decompiled. Five named constant-buffer bindings and the core GBuffer/depth/screen-shadow/wetness/SSR/AO texture roles plus the binning byte-address buffer are now closed. Binding 32 is role-identified as the 48-byte _LightBinningConstants buffer, its exact native producer field layout and upload are source-closed, and a default-off Unity publisher is D3D11/D3D12 GPU-verified for source-closed isolated Overview light counts. Offline IL2CPP/xref recovery additionally closes LightCullResult as pointer+count, its unique HGCullingSystem.CullLights producer, both direct HGCamera.DoECSCulling call sites, their exact 256-candidate cap, and the first SetupState consumer. The target-frame native pointer contents/count and therefore final retail lightCount remain capture-only. Binding 34 is source-closed as the 11,440-byte ShadowData layout. Binding 37 now has its exact 32-entry/2,560-byte native initialization and upload closed; a default-off zero-cookie publisher is D3D11/D3D12 GPU-verified for the source-closed isolated Wulfa/Zhuangfy Overview lists, while non-empty retail atlas values remain capture-only. Binding 38 is source-closed as the exact 3,568-byte HDPunctualLightCharacterShadowData layout by a matching original ScreenSpaceShadowResolve sidecar; its native manager, per-frame reset, push-pass packing, selected .y-only consumer, and exact pre-bind capture boundary are now closed. An inactive frame provably clears all 56 channel selectors, but persistent/frame-derived fields and the allocator-returned size prevent claiming a byte-exact zero fixture. All four debug-anonymous constant-buffer roles are therefore closed. Binary sampling behavior plus hash/offset-pinned installed shader identifiers close all 25 sampled texture roles. Exact installed CharInfo VolumeProfiles and HGEnvironmentPhase now source-close the scene's disabled wetness, volumetric-fog, cloud-shadow, ASM, and directional-shadow controls while proving that reflection remains live. All three serialized CharInfo BC6H Cubemaps are recovered exactly. The installed ReflectionProbeBinningCS asset, exact one-Cubemap slice-0 host contract, 576x576x32 RGBAHalf oct cache, and 4,160-byte ReflectionProbeGlobalData producer are now binary-source-closed; the source-derived Unity compute port is GPU-verified but deliberately unpublished. The retail deferred and volumetric binders also close both selected disabled texture paths: invalid wetness is Unity's white Texture2D, while disabled volumetric fog publishes the game's exact 1x1x1 black ASTC_4x4 Texture3D. The retail capsule-shadow pass additionally closes the VisibilitySH output descriptor as bilinear/clamp R16G16B16A16_SFloat and its empty/disabled publication as Texture2D.blackTexture. Both exact LUT payloads, the native 128x48-byte output ABI, exact native posed transform-to-record packing, Wulfa/Zhuang's ten authored candidates, and the selected additive producer pass are also source-closed. Complete pass-0 publication, settled posed capsule records and view-cull survivors, and remaining live per-frame resources are not yet closed.
